'''T4-M7''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] serving the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], it was sent to the [[Drill Site Control Center]] as a courier by [[Darth Mortis]] to help him enlist the services of the Imperial strike team regarding [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]].<ref name="The Old Republic" />
